bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for a grant to West Broadway Business and Area Coalition.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; WEST BROADWAY BUSINESS AND AREA COALITION.

$75,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $75,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to West Broadway Business and Area Coalition to support their ambassador program to help manage, maintain, and oversee the West Broadway Avenue corridor in the city of Minneapolis. These are onetime appropriations.
